exposure: information about birth during antenatal care
outcome: women's satisfaction with information about birth
perceived sufficiency of information about birth
cohort: 765 women attending antenatal care at 26 urban and rural health care centres in Iceland during the year 2009-2010
finding: Although the majority of women want to be informed about birth during antenatal care, many women felt that insufficient time was dedicated to this topic, with satisfaction levels varying based on mode of delivery and birth experience.
mod_finding: Women who had planned caesarean section were most satisfied with the time spent on antenatal information about birth.
